name: DevBox
postCreateCommand: sudo mount --make-rshared / && mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode ~/.local/share/opencode && ([ -f /tmp/host-sync/.gitconfig ] && cp /tmp/host-sync/.gitconfig ~/.gitconfig || true) && ([ -d /tmp/host-sync/gh ] && cp -rf /tmp/host-sync/gh ~/.config/ || true) && ([ -f /tmp/host-sync/opencode/opencode.json ] && cp /tmp/host-sync/opencode/opencode.json ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json || true) && ([ -f /tmp/host-sync/opencode-share/auth.json ] && cp /tmp/host-sync/opencode-share/auth.json ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json || true) && echo 'DevBox Ready'
